pages.title: Magnetic Monopoles
pages.text: $(thing)Magnetic Monopoles$()$(br2)Grand unified theories say magnetic charges must exist, made in the first instant - and Dirac showed that one would explain why every electric charge is a whole number of e. The Pulsed Magnet Lab can search for them in magnetar crust.
